about: Saint-Bruno-de-Montarville is a South Shore city in Montérégie, at the foot of Mont Saint-Bruno east of Longueuil. An affluent suburban community wraps around Parc national du Mont-Saint-Bruno and a historic village core. Ski slopes, apple orchards, and mountain trails sit inside and beside the city. About 26,000 people live in Saint-Bruno-de-Montarville.
